about: William C. Jhaveri-Weeks is a top-rated attorney who practices law in San Francisco, California. William Jhaveri-Weeks focuses on Employment Litigation: Plaintiff issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Class Action / Mass Torts: Plaintiff, Civil Litigation: Plaintiff and Civil Litigation: Defense.

William Jhaveri-Weeks received Super Lawyers designation for 2021 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 2008. Before practicing law, he attended law school at New York University School of Law and graduated in 2007.
